scenario: Collect the current public security, privacy, and subprocessors pages for five approved SaaS vendors and flag material changes since last quarter.

messages.text: Collect the current public security, privacy, and subprocessors pages for five approved SaaS vendors and flag material changes since last quarter.
I identified the website decision, the evidence needed, and the boundary that must stay human-owned.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.
I produced outputs/website-evidence-collector-handoff.md, with facts, assumptions, open questions, and the next accountable owner separated.

report.title: Website evidence collector session handoff
report.summary: A capped, allowlisted Firecrawl retrieval with timestamps and hashes, normalized change evidence, original links, collection failures, and reviewer questions without authentication or publication.

items.title: Collection scope and allowlist
items.summary: Every retrieval is inside the approved domain and path scope and records final URL, time, status, and evidence identity

items.title: Retrieval and error ledger
items.summary: Collection stayed within the declared page, byte, usage, and retention limits

items.title: Normalized evidence set
items.summary: Do not crawl outside the approved domains or paths, evade robots or access controls, authenticate, submit forms, or retrieve personal, confidential, paywalled, or prohibited content

items.title: Content-change comparison
items.summary: The final answer names the accountable next owner and preserves the reusable artifact path.
